summary: [standards] The bodies assert 1.4 but the function names still say 1_2 or 1_1 (atip_claiml2_01_every_envelope_declares_1_2..., _02_no_consumer_spells_canons_declaration_as_1_1, _07_..._deep_at_1_2, _09_the_fixture_claims_1_2...), and the junit case names are the evidence identity.
